label: PF Backlog 219
title: Backend: post-ideation capability & model-strategy gate (select modalities/kinds/models right after ideation)
body:
## Problem / why BI-0192 selects the model/capability strategy only AFTER the architect (1b). But modality is knowable right after ideation (0/0a), and later stages (design/architecture) already need to know the kinds and capability pack. Choosing too late under-serves early decisions and blocks media-aware design. ## Goal & value Add a FIRST selection point immediately after ideation/discovery, keeping the post-architect pass as a refinement (progressive elaboration). ## In scope - Gate A (post-ideation 0/0a): detect modalities (core/modality.py) -> write `products/

/capabilities.json` (required_capabilities) -> ENABLE the capability packs (BI-0189) -> pick coarse model KINDS + a provisional free/paid mix. - Gate B (post-architect 1b, existing BI-0192): refine to concrete models/providers + per-stage tier. - Wire into the executor right after discovery/design so downstream stages see the pack. - Surface the decision (which modalities/kinds/packs) in the run log + telemetry. ## Acceptance criteria (testable) - A media idea enables its pack BEFORE the design stage runs. - A non-media idea enables nothing and behaves exactly as today. - Changing the idea re-runs the gate and updates capabilities.json idempotently. ## Verification / test plan - Unit: gate A decision table (idea -> modalities -> packs -> kinds). - Integration: app idea vs reels idea -> different enabled caps visible to stage 1.
